text: Ekoï is a French cycling-equipment company founded in Roubaix in 2001 by Jean-Christophe Rattel and headquartered in Fréjus. In 2019 its minority shareholders since 2014 (Amundi, Sofipaca and Jean-Fabrice Mathieu) sold their stakes to Rattel, so that JCR Ekoï is owned 100% by him.
short: Ekoï is owned 100% by its founder Jean-Christophe Rattel (since 2019).

source.name: TOUR Magazin, 'Ekoi interview: Many brands will disappear' (interview with CEO Jean-Christophe Rattel)
source.quote: The French brand Ekoi was founded in Roubaix in 2001 and is now headquartered in Fréjus.
source.note: The page's 'About the person' block states Rattel founded Ekoï in 2001 together with a friend; machine-translated English version of a German original.
